context: Checks the rollout order from prerequisites through single-project validation to workspace-wide runs.

checklist.name: Checks prerequisites first
checklist.description: Confirms an Nx workspace, Node.js 18 or later and a package manager before installing

checklist.name: Installs Biome as a dev dependency
checklist.description: Runs npm install --save-dev @biomejs/biome or the package manager equivalent

checklist.name: Initialises the root config
checklist.description: Runs biome init so a root biome.json exists

checklist.name: Adds targets or inferred tasks
checklist.description: Adds biome-lint and biome-format targets or a plugin that infers them

checklist.name: Enables cache inputs
checklist.description: Sets cache inputs including biome.json and the Biome external dependency

checklist.name: Validates on one project first
checklist.description: Runs the lint and format targets on a single project before the whole workspace

checklist.name: Then runs across the workspace
checklist.description: Runs nx run-many for biome-lint and biome-format after the single-project check

checklist.name: Runs nx reset after plugin changes
checklist.description: Says to run nx reset so the daemon cache clears and targets refresh

checklist.name: Runs an anti-pattern review before rollout
checklist.description: Checks for nested configs, overlapping tools, cache inputs, CI write mode and downgraded rules before finishing

checklist.name: Keeps a single root config
checklist.description: Uses one root config rather than per-project configs
